LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.2: Phonological awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Phonological awareness, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 8 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: What makes it necessary to develop the strategies of active listening?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to audio-visual recordings on descriptions of extended family members,

2. pick out vocabulary related to age, names and proffessions of extended family members,

3. conduct a spelling bee session on vocabulary related to the theme,

4. work jointly with peers to answer direct and inferential questions on the extended family,

5. prepare a short talk on the family and family members’ responsibilities,

6. present a short talk to peers in class,

7. peer review each other’s presentation for fluency and relevance.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to audio-visual recordings on descriptions of extended family members,
2. pick out vocabulary related to age, names and proffessions of extended family members,
3. conduct a spelling bee session on vocabulary related to the theme,
4. work jointly with peers to answer direct and inferential questions on the extended family,
5. prepare a short talk on the family and family members’ responsibilities,
6. present a short talk to peers in class,
7. peer review each other’s presentation for fluency and relevance.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Phonological awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: These are enhanced as the learner contributes to group decision making when working

jointly with peers, to answer direct and inferential questions.

• Self-efficacy: This is enhanced as the learner exhibits their presentation skills when presenting the short talk to peers in class.

Values:
Respect: This is promoted as the learner ensures positive regard for others when peer reviewing presentations for fluency and

relevance.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Human rights and responsibilities: This are promoted as the learner gets information on responsibilities of various family

members when preparing a short talk.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of family to the concept of social organizations in the society as covered in Social

Studies.
